product_overview: QT Office Banking Workflow is a comprehensive system designed to manage banks, corporations, users, and cheque processing with strict role-based access and digital signature management to ensure secure and accurate financial operations.
core_goals: Enable creation and management of banks and corporations with full required details.
Provide role-based controls differentiating Super Admin and Admin capabilities.
Allow assignment of unassigned bank accounts to users during user creation.
Integrate digital signature uploading and assignment by Super Admins to banks.
Automate cheque printing with all necessary bank details, assigned digital signatures, and auto-incrementing check numbers.
key_features: Add Bank Page with form validation including mandatory fields, routing and account number format checks, and duplicate DBA prevention.
Corporation Management allowing creation and assignment of multiple banks.
Signature Management page for Super Admin to upload and assign digital signatures to banks with file preview functionality.
Add User Page showing unassigned banks with live search, multi-select checkboxes, and user-bank assignment on save.
APIs supporting unassigned bank retrieval, bank creation, user-bank assignment, and signature uploading.
Cheque Printing logic pulling bank and signature data with auto-incrementing cheque numbers.
JWT-based authentication and role-based access control ensuring permissions integrity.
Database schema structured around Banks, Corporations, Users, Signatures, and related models.
user_flow_summary: Admin logs in and accesses Add Bank page to create new bank entries. Validations ensure correct data before saving.
Super Admin navigates to Signature Management page, selects banks needing signatures, uploads PNG/JPEG files, and assigns them.
Admin creates a new user via Add User page where unassigned bank accounts are listed with search and multi-selection capabilities. Upon saving, selected banks get assigned to the user.
Cheque creation processes pull requisite bank details and digital signatures for printing with auto-incremented cheque numbers.
validation_criteria: All bank creation fields are mandatory and validated for format (routing number: 9 digits, zip and account number numeric) and duplicate DBA rejection.
Signature upload allowed only for Super Admin, with file type restrictions (PNG/JPEG), and once assigned cannot be overwritten by Admin.
Add User page must display all unassigned banks and allow multiple selections with real-time search capabilities.
Cheque printing must show correct bank data, return address, digital signature, and increment cheque numbers uniquely per bank.
APIs must return accurate data and enforce security checks corresponding to user roles.

features.name: Add User Page
features.description: Page for creating users and managing bank account assignments. Displays unassigned accounts with checkboxes for selection.

features.name: Unassigned Banks API
features.description: API endpoint that returns all banks where assigned_to_user_id IS NULL. Returns id, dbaName, accountType, and bankName.

features.name: Assign Banks API
features.description: API endpoint to assign selected bank IDs to a user. Updates assigned_to_user_id field.

features.name: Bank Management
features.description: Add bank form with account type selection and bank creation functionality.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: JWT-based authentication system with role-based access control.

features.name: Database Schema
features.description: Prisma schema defining Bank, User, Signer, Signature, and Check models with relationships.
